glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 竹 (“bamboo”) + phonetic 寺. 竹 here refers to the bamboo strips used for writing (e.g. grading, classification) in ancient times. 寺 was originally used phonetically; the character was subsequently borrowed for another word with the same meaning, but with no phonetic resemblance to 寺.
senses: [děng] (obsolete in standard Chinese) to arrange bamboo slips neatly
